With the consent, heard finally.
Perused the case diary.

This is first application filed under Section 439 of Cr.P.C for grant of bail to the applicant, as he has been arrested on 13.05.2023 in connection with Crime No.83/2023 registered at Police Station Rithorakala, District Morena (M.P.) for commission of offence punishable under Sections 363, 376,
376(2)

1 (n) of IPC and Section 5L/6 of POCSO Act.
Prosecution case, in brief, is that on 11.05.2023 applicant kidnapped the minor prosecutrix aged about 17 years 11 months and got her seated in a bus and took her to Jaipur, where he committed rape upon her.
Learned counsel for the applicant submits that the applicant is innocent a n d has falsely been implicated in the matter.

sentences.text: He further submits that the prosecutrix was major at the time of incident.

The prosecutrix in her statement recorded under Section 164 of Cr.P.C. on 15.05.2023 specifically stated that she had gone with the applicant on her own will and thereafter she changed her version and stated in her another statement recorded under Section 164 of Cr.P.C. on 28.06.2023 that the applicant got her seated in a bus and took her to Jaipur and committed rape upon her.
As her statements with regard to the incident are contradictory, therefore, the whole prosecution story becomes doubtful.
No offence is made out against the applicant.
The applicant is in custody since 13.05.2023.
His custodial interrogation or trial is not required in the matter.
Trial will take time for its conclusion.
Hence, prayer is made to enlarge the applicant on bail.
Learned counsel for the respondent/State opposes the application on the ground that the prosecutrix was minor on the date of incident.
Offences made against the applicant are serious in nature.
Therefore, he be not released on bail.

Having considered the rival submissions, material pointed out by learned counsel for the applicant,
evidence produced on record with regard to the age of the prosecutrix and her contradictory statements recorded under Section 164 of Cr.P.C. and also considering the other facts and circumstances of the case, this Court is of the view that applicant deserves to be enlarged on bail,
hence, without commenting anything on the merits of the cas e, the application is allowed.
It is directed that the applicant be released on bail upon his furnishing personal bond in the sum of Rs.50,000/- (Rupees Fifty thousand only) with a solvent surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of the concerned Court for his appearance before the Trial Court on all such dates as may be fixed in this behalf by the Trial Court during the pendency of trial.
It is further directed that applicant shall comply with the provisions of Section 437 (3) of Cr. P. C.
This application is allowed and stands disposed of.
Certified copy, as per rules.
